20: #define D13X_FB_WIDTH          1024u
21: #define D13X_FB_HEIGHT         600u
22: #define D13X_FB_BPP            16u
23: #define D13X_FB_STRIDE         (D13X_FB_WIDTH * 2u)
24: #define D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE     (D13X_FB_STRIDE * D13X_FB_HEIGHT)
25: #define D13X_FB_BUFFERS        2u
26: #define D13X_FB_TOTAL_SIZE     (D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
27: #define D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE   32u
28: #define D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT (64u * 1024u)
29: #define THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN   (1u << 1)
30: 
31: struct d13x_fb_state_s
32: {
33:   bool initialized;
34:   bool power_on;
35:   uint8_t *memory;
36: };

40: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache(void)
41: {
42:   uint32_t mhcr;
43: 
44:   /* The custom D13x port does not expose NuttX ARCH_DCACHE hooks, while the
45:    * E907 may inherit an enabled write-back cache from the bootloader.  Use
46:    * the vendor's numeric CSR and raw dcache.call encoding so ordinary GCC
47:    * toolchains still make framebuffer writes visible to the DE DMA master.
48:    */
49: 
50:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
51:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) != 0)
52:     {
53:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
54:       __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0010000b" ::: "memory");
55:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
56:     }
57: }
58: 
59: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(const void *address, size_t row_bytes,
60:                                      size_t stride, size_t row_count)
61: {
62:   uintptr_t row;
63:   uint32_t mhcr;
64:   size_t index;
65: 
66:   if (row_bytes == 0 || row_count == 0)
67:     {
68:       return;
69:     }
70: 
71:   /* A cache-wide clean is bounded by the cache capacity and is faster than
72:    * issuing tens of thousands of per-line operations for a large redraw.
73:    */
74: 
75:   if (row_bytes * row_count >= D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT)
76:     {
77:       d13x_fb_clean_cache();
78:       return;
79:     }
80: 
81:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
82:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) == 0)
83:     {
84:       return;
85:     }
86: 
87:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence" ::: "memory");
88:   row = (uintptr_t)address;
89:   for (index = 0; index < row_count; index++)
90:     {
91:       uintptr_t current = row & ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
92:       uintptr_t end = (row + row_bytes + D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u) &
93:                       ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
94: 
95:       while (current < end)
96:         {
97:           register uintptr_t cache_address __asm__("a0") = current;
98: 
99:           /* T-Head dcache.cpa cleans one physical cache line. */
100: 
101:           __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0295000b" : "+r"(cache_address) ::
102:                                "memory");
103:           current += D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE;
104:         }
105: 
106:       row += stride;
107:     }
108: 
109:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence\n\t"
110:                        "fence.i\n\t"
111:                        ".long 0x01a0000b" ::: "memory");
112: }

197: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
198:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
199: {
200:   uintptr_t address;
201: 
202:   (void)vtable;
203: 
204:   if (pinfo == NULL || !g_fb.initialized ||
205:       (pinfo->yoffset != 0 && pinfo->yoffset != D13X_FB_HEIGHT))
206:     {
207:       return -EINVAL;
208:     }
209: 
210:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE;
211: 
212:   /* LVGL uses DIRECT double buffering.  Before drawing a new dirty area it
213:    * copies the previous frame's dirty areas into the back buffer so both
214:    * framebuffers remain identical.  FBIO_UPDATE only describes the current
215:    * dirty area and therefore does not cover those synchronization copies.
216:    * Cleaning just that area can leave stale cache lines in the back buffer,
217:    * which appear as old labels and widgets after the subsequent page flip.
218:    *
219:    * Clean the complete (finite) data cache immediately before publishing the
220:    * buffer.  This makes every LVGL write visible to the DE DMA master.  It is
221:    * also cheaper than walking the entire 1.2 MiB framebuffer line by line.
222:    */

224:   d13x_fb_clean_cache();

142:     uint32_t data_size = h * stride;

153:         lv_display_set_draw_buffers(disp, &dsc->buf1, &dsc->buf2);

156:         dsc->mem_off_screen = malloc(data_size);
157:         LV_ASSERT_MALLOC(dsc->mem_off_screen);

159:             ret = -ENOMEM;

237: static void flush_cb(lv_display_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area, uint8_t * color_p)
238: {
239:     LV_UNUSED(color_p);
240:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
241: 
242:     if(dsc->mem_off_screen) {
243:         /* When rendering in off-screen mode, copy the drawing buffer to fb */
244:         /* buf2(off-screen buffer) -> buf1(fbmem)*/
245:         lv_draw_buf_copy(&dsc->buf1, area, &dsc->buf2, area);
246:     }
247: 
248:     /* Skip the non-last flush */
249: 
250:     if(!lv_display_flush_is_last(disp)) {
251:         lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
252:         return;
253:     }
254: 
255: #if defined(CONFIG_FB_UPDATE)
256:     /*May be some direct update command is required*/
257:     int yoffset = disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1 ?
258:                   0 : dsc->mem2_yoffset;
259: 
260:     /* Join the areas to update */
261:     lv_area_t final_inv_area;
262:     lv_memzero(&final_inv_area, sizeof(final_inv_area));
263:     fbdev_join_inv_areas(disp, &final_inv_area);
264: 
265:     struct fb_area_s fb_area;
266:     fb_area.x = final_inv_area.x1;
267:     fb_area.y = final_inv_area.y1 + yoffset;
268:     fb_area.w = lv_area_get_width(&final_inv_area);
269:     fb_area.h = lv_area_get_height(&final_inv_area);
270:     if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIO_UPDATE, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&fb_area)) < 0) {
271:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIO_UPDATE) failed: %d", errno);
272:     }
273: #endif

275:     /* double framebuffer */
276: 
277:     if(dsc->mem2 != NULL) {
278:         if(disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1) {
279:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = 0;
280:         }
281:         else {
282:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = dsc->mem2_yoffset;
283:         }
284: 
285:         if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIOPAN_DISPLAY, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t) & (dsc->pinfo))) < 0) {
286:             LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOPAN_DISPLAY) failed: %d", errno);
287:         }
288: #if defined(CONFIG_FB_SYNC)
289:         if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC, 0) < 0) {
290:             LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC) failed: %d", errno);
291:         }
292: #endif
293:     }
294:     lv_display_flush_ready(disp);

302:         case FB_FMT_RGB24:

304:         case FB_FMT_RGB32:

306:         case FB_FMT_RGBA32:

308:         default:

320:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ERROR: ioctl(FBIOGET_PLANEINFO) failed: %d", errno);
321:         return -errno;
322:     }
323: 
324:     LV_LOG_USER("PlaneInfo (plane %d):", pinfo->display);
325:     LV_LOG_USER("    mem: %p", pinfo->fbmem);
326:     LV_LOG_USER("    fblen: %zu", pinfo->fblen);
327:     LV_LOG_USER("   stride: %u", pinfo->stride);
328:     LV_LOG_USER("  display: %u", pinfo->display);
329:     LV_LOG_USER("      bpp: %u", pinfo->bpp);
330: 
331:     return 0;

334: static int fbdev_init_mem2(lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc)
335: {
336:     uintptr_t buf_offset;
337:     struct fb_planeinfo_s pinfo;
338:     int ret;
339: 
340:     lv_memzero(&pinfo, sizeof(pinfo));
341: 
342:     /* Get display[1] planeinfo */
343: 
344:     pinfo.display = dsc->pinfo.display + 1;
345: 
346:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &pinfo)) < 0) {
347:         return ret;
348:     }
349: 
350:     /* Check bpp */
351: 
352:     if(pinfo.bpp != dsc->pinfo.bpp) {
353:         LV_LOG_WARN("mem2 is incorrect");
354:         return -EINVAL;
355:     }
356: 
357:     /* Check the buffer address offset,
358:      * It needs to be divisible by pinfo.stride
359:      */
360: 
361:     buf_offset = pinfo.fbmem - dsc->mem;
362: 
363:     if((buf_offset % dsc->pinfo.stride) != 0) {
364:         LV_LOG_WARN("It is detected that buf_offset(%" PRIuPTR ") "
365:                     "and stride(%d) are not divisible, please ensure "
366:                     "that the driver handles the address offset by itself.",
367:                     buf_offset, dsc->pinfo.stride);
368:     }
369: 
370:     /* Calculate the address and yoffset of mem2 */
371: 
372:     if(buf_offset == 0) {
373:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = dsc->vinfo.yres;
374:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem + dsc->mem2_yoffset * pinfo.stride;
375:         LV_LOG_USER("Use consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
376:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
377:     }
378:     else {
379:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = buf_offset / dsc->pinfo.stride;
380:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem;
381:         LV_LOG_USER("Use non-consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
382:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
383:     }
384: 
385:     return 0;
386: }
